chunks: And from him, from Safwan, from Mansur, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
He said to me: 'Seek forgiveness from Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, in the Witr prayer seventy times.'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended dhikr to recite during the Witr prayer according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Sahih al-Tusi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) instructs Abu Abdillah to recite Istighfar seventy times during the Witr prayer, emphasizing the spiritual purification associated with the concluding night prayer. This practice underscores the Shia emphasis on integrating repentance into the final units of night worship, reflecting the prophetic tradition of seeking divine mercy before concluding one's devotions.
